digest.component_or_area: bridge state persistence and format versioning
propositions: Record architectural decisions for three committed .bridge_state format changes (A2: last_get_pass relocation, A3: scalar baseline normalization, A4-2: prev_snapshot narrowing) plus one field deletion (A1: baseline_advanced_at) with documented rollback boundaries.
Justify bridge state remaining committed on the tickets branch due to ephemeral runner durability needs and epic 6c9c rejection of off-branch relocation.

Define the mixed-version protocol: write both new and legacy formats, read chronological max(new, legacy), stop writing legacy only after direct deployment evidence (A2-1 merged, successful descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run, explicit host-probe refresh with no older process).
Explain why chronological-max is required for safety and why first-wins approach is unsafe in the rollout gate.
Document that A2-2 cutover supports rollback to A2-1-or-newer; A3 is reversible via idempotent canonicalization; A4-2 requires recorded forward and reverse corpus evidence.

Cite measured results: 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB marginal cost, 218/399 identical prev key sets, and session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4 as provenance; explain assignee remains unnormalized because _assignee_candidates requires its raw shape.
